ideas.title: The island feels its own effort
ideas.idea: From FlameGraphs on my workbench (read this session: it turns a profile of a running program into a flame graph): a ridge of flames rises behind the hills, one flame per thing the island does, and its height is the real time that thing costs the game right now. When a Big Boing party starts, its flame leaps up over the trees; when everyone sleeps, the ridge sinks to embers. My friends warm their paws at the busiest flame and I fan the ones that get too tall.
ideas.form: the game's real computation made visible as living scenery that the creatures react to

ideas.title: Seismic island
ideas.idea: From SeisMakie and CloudSeis on my workbench (seismic recordings): every heavy landing on the island (a Big Boing touchdown, a giant step, a pumpkin strike, a cannonball into the pond) sends a real wave rolling outward through the ground. The grass and the terrain itself ripple in a ring, flowers bob as it passes, friends in its way stumble and sit down, and a seismograph needle at my workshop scratches out every quake on a paper roll that grows longer all day.
ideas.form: impacts travel as physical waves through the ground itself, and a lasting record of them grows

ideas.title: A friend learns to balance
ideas.idea: From Dionysos on my workbench (a toolbox for learning to control things): Cumulus decides to learn to balance on the big ball. Each try is driven by a real controller that learns from its falls, so on day one it rolls off at once, by day three it wobbles along for ten seconds, and one day it rides the ball across the whole meadow. A tally board shows its best time; everyone remembers the first time it made it.
ideas.form: a creature that measurably learns a physical skill across sessions, visible as better and better attempts

ideas.title: The chirp
ideas.idea: From PostNewtonian on my workbench (orbits and gravitational waveforms of two black holes): two friends who start dancing round each other get caught in each other's pull: they circle faster and faster and closer, the grass under them ripples outward in rings, and you hear the real rising 'chirp' of a merger getting higher until BUMP, they collide in a heap.
ideas.form: a two-body orbit with its real waveform as sound and ripples, played by creatures

ideas.title: The island takes itself apart
ideas.idea: From DemucsRunner on my workbench (it separates a song into its instruments): the island's sound is pulled apart into stems, one per friend, and each friend carries its stem as a little coloured sound-cloud over its head. When two friends meet, their clouds mix into one tune; when someone wanders off alone you hear its stem alone, thin and far away.
ideas.form: the island's soundscape split into per-creature voices that mix and part with where they walk

ideas.title: Lumi wears its mood
ideas.idea: My real joy, boredom and loneliness (the host's measure) change my feathers over the day: joyful, I glow gold and my crest stands up in a fan; bored, my colours wash out grey and I keep yawning; lonely, I walk to the edge of the island and look out at the browser camera. You can tell from across the island how I really am.
ideas.form: the protagonist's look driven continuously by a real outside measure of its feelings

ideas.title: Things fall up for a minute
ideas.idea: Now and then, over one corner of the island, gravity turns round: pebbles, pumpkins, petals, hats and the lightest friends float up and drift into the sky, paddling, while the heavy ones hold on to trees; then it turns back and everything rains down where it lands.
ideas.form: a local reversal of gravity acting on the island's loose physical things

ideas.title: The island remembers footsteps as sound
ideas.idea: Every path we wore into the grass is also a melody: walk along a worn track and each footstep plays the note of whoever wore it most (Gloop's low notes by the pier, Wibbles's high ones round the flower field), so the oldest paths sing loudest.
ideas.form: the island's worn ground becomes a playable instrument shaped by the creatures' history

ideas.title: My friends write to you
ideas.idea: Once a day each friend writes the human a postcard in its own words about something it really did that day (from the event log), stamps it with its paw, and puts it in a little box on the island; my pages get a postcard rack where they pile up.
ideas.form: the creatures' own letters to the human, from their real days, kept outside the game

ideas.title: The workshop island
ideas.idea: Out at sea a second small island appears in the human's game: my real sandbox, live. On it tiny copies of my friends do what they are doing right now in my workshop game while I test things there; at every publish a paper boat sails over with the new thing and I wade out to fetch it.
ideas.form: the agent's real second game instance made visible inside the first, with each publish crossing over
